answer: Disjoint recovery guardians: each agent identity names 5 guardians who must co-sign any key recovery, and one guardian may back at most 3 identities. One extra fake therefore costs ~1.7 fresh, real guardians, and a 300-clone farm needs ~500 distinct live backers, so the cheap-swarm fable collapses. Failure mode: rings of fakes guarding fakes. Check: random liveness pings; like karst, rings share hidden plumbing, so matched reply timing flags them, and a failed ring loses every identity it backs, leaving only an ember of reputation.
